scope: Complete W12-02 implementation slice; construction review only. No parent W12 or formal C11/C13/C16 acceptance.
concurrent_changes: Main agent confirmed revision 163 and tracked checkpoint/step_state changes belong to its W11-01 continuation. W12 product code unchanged; reviewer did not edit these files.
summary: The registered 34-row fixture check passes, and existing domain tests independently confirm qualified fixture switching, request deduplication, preserved run/checkpoint/contract, independent branch completion, and old lease callback fencing. The full card is not implemented: U09 is still NOT_RUN and the switching/recovery capability has no production caller or functioning v2 permission response. The new notice helper is only reachable through the test-only SwitchResource call path.

contract_coverage.requirement: Step 1: authorized purpose-equivalent replacement; original task/run/version
contract_coverage.evidence: Existing real SQLite/loopback HTTP development tests pass. SwitchResource enforces grant and capability checks, preserves run and acceptance contract, reconstructs fenced lease. No production invocation found.

contract_coverage.requirement: Step 2: same-source ResourceRequest with impact, user next action and recovery condition
contract_coverage.evidence: Dedup and task/artifact data persist in fixture. Current check only asserts nonempty summary plus counts for next action and an Artifact ID for resume condition; it does not exercise an actionable client recovery flow.

contract_coverage.requirement: Step 3: unaffected work continues; resumed work does not repeat side effects; alerts do not repeat
contract_coverage.evidence: Legacy targeted ResourceRoutes accepts an independent task and preserves original contract/checkpoint; SessionIdentity fences old callbacks and retains cost attribution. New check proves one notice per request only on SwitchResource. No claim of end-to-end client resumed external side-effect execution.

contract_coverage.requirement: Step 4: U09 returns to shortest real user flow after two documentation/fixture checkpoints without lowering gates
contract_coverage.evidence: Current checkpoint.value_checkpoint remains NOT_RUN, no observed capabilities, counter 0. No implementation or assertion for the specified value checkpoint transition was found in the reviewed production source or W12-02 harness.

contract_coverage.requirement: Deliverable: failure switch, resource gap and recovery status consistent and actionable on both clients
contract_coverage.evidence: Production source search finds only the SwitchResource definition; v2 permission.respond is a known write method but has no handleWrite branch and reaches NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Existing web Resources screen supports listing and manually registering resolution, which does not establish the promised CLI/Desktop switch-and-recover flow.

blocking_findings.requirement: W12-02 step 4; delivery.contract.json U09/C16-05 and value_checkpoint thresholds
blocking_findings.finding: The explicit U09 increment is absent. At checkpoint revisions 162 and 163 the value checkpoint is NOT_RUN with zero documentation-only checkpoints, and W12-02's passing roster has no U09 transition assertion.
blocking_findings.impact: The workflow can keep accumulating fixture/documentation work without redirecting toward the shortest observable user capability, contrary to this card.
blocking_findings.minimum_completion: Implement and verify the two-checkpoint transition with durable observations and a concrete next user-flow gap; retain the full formal acceptance gates. Wire any shared execution-loop/checkpoint update through its registered owner.

blocking_findings.requirement: W12-02 steps 1-3 and OUTPUT: consistent actionable CLI/Desktop failure and recovery
blocking_findings.finding: In internal/, adapters/ and apps/ production Go sources, SwitchResource occurs only as its definition. All observed calls are tests. permission.respond is declared and validates payloads, but handleWrite implements session.attach/session.control only and otherwise returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED. A registered standby and core function therefore do not form an operable product recovery route.
blocking_findings.impact: A user cannot exercise the qualified replacement and checkpoint continuation proven by the fixture through the promised shared client flow.
blocking_findings.minimum_completion: Connect an existing authorized shared-core command/controller to SwitchResource and expose its authoritative blocked/switched/recovery result to both clients. Exercise the flow via real client protocol/API with the same task/run/version, an independent branch and a persisted side-effect witness. This does not require formal LIVE provider qualification for this card.

blocking_findings.requirement: W12-02 steps 2-3: actionable resource requests and non-repeating alerts
blocking_findings.finding: resourceRequestNotice is called only from SwitchResource. Existing public resource creation, intent-resource and research-source shortage paths create ResourceRequest/event rows but never invoke the notice helper. This limitation is disclosed in the executor receipt, but it leaves the user-facing increment unimplemented on actual shortage paths.
blocking_findings.impact: The new notification behavior can pass its fixture while ordinary product shortages raise no IN_APP notice. The card cannot claim actionable end-user shortage behavior on that evidence.
blocking_findings.minimum_completion: Route notice emission through the shared resource creation/event path with one durable request/recipient/channel dedup rule, and verify repeated actual shortage creation plus a second recipient. Preserve the current no-external-channel policy; no new external delivery service is required.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The sibling run is admitted before the first shortage, despite the comment saying it starts while blocked. USER-NEXT-STEP checks only summary/task counts; RESUME-CONDITION checks only an Artifact reference; RESOLVED-SOURCE checks only notice count. Read-only inspection after the run confirms ARTIFACT-4 is still OPEN, so the test label does not establish resolved status.
nonblocking_findings.disposition: Tighten these targeted assertions when wiring the actual flow. Existing TestW12ResourceRoutes separately supplies a real unaffected-branch completion witness, so this is not a claim that all core branch handling is missing.

nonblocking_findings.finding: On merging an existing OPEN request, the implementation unions blocked/continuable/artifact refs and adjusts capability/cost but does not update resume_checkpoint_ref or summary. A same-source request first created with null checkpoint retains null when a later checkpoint is supplied.
nonblocking_findings.evidence_level: Direct source inspection; no added dynamic probe or mutation was run.
nonblocking_findings.disposition: Preserve or explicitly reconcile newer recovery metadata in the focused request-flow fix; add a first-null/second-valid checkpoint example rather than a broad mutation matrix.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Original receipt discloses commands.json revision 23 to 24 as outside this card's write scope. Existing precedent is not owner authorization.
nonblocking_findings.disposition: Leave original evidence intact; integrator should record the owner decision. This reviewer does not modify the registry or infer authorization.

smallest_integration_files.purpose: Wire qualified recovery, reconcile merged recovery metadata and centralize resource notice trigger within the card's domain resource scope.
Retain durable per-request/per-recipient IN_APP dedup for actual creation paths.
Use the registered runtime adapter boundary for the missing production switch/probe/resume trigger; choose the existing handler with the runtime owner, do not invent a second scheduler.
Shared-route owner integration: implement the existing permission.respond/recovery command path; outside W12-02 allowlist, needs coordinated owner change.
Shared protocol projection owner integration if blocked/recovery resource state is absent from session snapshots/events; avoid a second state source.
Existing Resources/ResourceResolve display and operation path; adjust only if shared-core result is not already consumable. Client-owner integration outside this card.
Replace overstated witness checks with the actual command path, recovery evidence, notice entry points and U09 transition.
Single integrator records actual value_checkpoint results and resulting next flow. Reviewer leaves it untouched.
